That changes it: `git pull` by default runs `git fetch` followed by `git merge`, not rebase. Your teammate's history wasn't rewritten by a standard pull—rebase only kicks in with `--rebase` flag or `pull.rebase=true` in config.

If history actually got rewritten, they either used an explicit rebase flag, had that config set, or something else rewrote it (force push, reset, or a rebase on another branch).
